edition: 沪教版（五四制）2026秋 · 五年级上册
sourcePolicy: 内容以 Jayceeli/hujiao-grade5-english 当前 2026 教材 JSON 为唯一教材基线；第三方 GitHub 项目仅借鉴笔记数据结构，不直接套用其教材知识点。

unit-1.summary: 围绕校园社团谈论选择、计划和兴趣，并能简单描述参加社团的原因与体验。
focus: 用 be going to 表达近期计划或打算
用 How about ...? 提建议
掌握社团活动相关动名词和短语

grammar.pattern: be going to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: I'm going to join the Photography Club this term.
grammar.example: We are going to make a photo journal.
grammar.tip: be 要随主语变化：I am / he is / they are。

grammar.pattern: How about + 名词 / V-ing?
grammar.anchor: How about bamboo?
grammar.example: How about joining the Art Club?
grammar.tip: how about 后接动作时用 V-ing，不用动词原形。

grammar.pattern: one of + the + 形容词 + 复数名词
grammar.anchor: one of the four noble plants
grammar.example: Photography is one of the popular clubs at school.
grammar.tip: one of 后面的可数名词必须用复数。

pitfalls.wrong: I going to join the club.
pitfalls.right: I'm going to join the club.
pitfalls.why: be going to 结构不能漏掉 be。
How about 后接动词时用 V-ing。

pitfalls.wrong: one of the four noble plant
pitfalls.right: one of the four noble plants
pitfalls.why: one of 后接复数名词。

unit-2.summary: 围绕中国传统游戏和武术动作进行介绍，学会用祈使句给动作指令，并描述动作的样子和速度。
focus: 祈使句：动词原形开头
look like 表示“看起来像”
as ... as 表示同级比较

grammar.pattern: 动词原形 + ...
grammar.meaning: 祈使句，用于指令、建议或邀请
grammar.anchor: Stand like a pine tree.
grammar.example: Keep the same pace.
grammar.tip: 肯定祈使句通常省略主语 you，直接用动词原形。

grammar.pattern: What does ... look like? / ... looks like ...
grammar.anchor: What does this look like?
grammar.example: The action looks like a tree.
grammar.tip: 问句有 does 时，look 用原形。

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词/副词原级 + as
grammar.anchor: As fast as the wind.
grammar.example: He runs as fast as his teammate.
grammar.tip: 中间使用原级，不用 faster。

pitfalls.wrong: To stand like a pine tree.
pitfalls.why: 表示动作指令的祈使句直接以动词原形开头。
does 后的实义动词用原形。
as ... as 中使用形容词/副词原级。

unit-3.summary: 学习植物部位、特征与天气反应，能够描述植物的外形，并用条件句说明天气变化。
focus: look like 描述外形
If 条件句 + be going to 预测结果
植物科普常用动词短语

grammar.pattern: look(s) like + 名词
grammar.anchor: This one looks like an ice cream cone.
grammar.example: The leaf looks like a small umbrella.
grammar.tip: 主语为第三人称单数时 look 要加 -s。

grammar.pattern: If + 一般现在时, ... be going to + 动词原形
grammar.meaning: 如果某情况发生，预测将会……
grammar.anchor: If the flowers close up ..., it is going to be a sunny day.
grammar.example: If the sky gets dark, it is going to rain.
grammar.tip: if 从句表达条件时，本单元这类句子不用 will/be going to 放在 if 从句里。

grammar.pattern: be covered with + 名词
grammar.anchor: The wall is covered with plants.
grammar.example: The ground is covered with leaves.
grammar.tip: with 后接覆盖物。

pitfalls.why: 主语 it 为第三人称单数。

pitfalls.wrong: If it will rain, the petals close.
pitfalls.right: If it rains, the petals close.
pitfalls.why: 表示真实条件时，if 从句通常用一般现在时表达将来条件。

pitfalls.right: The wall is covered with plants.
pitfalls.why: “被植物覆盖”使用 be covered with。

unit-4.summary: 围绕动物观察和野生动物园活动进行交流，重点学习感官系动词、部分否定以及观察动作的表达。
focus: feel/look/taste + 形容词
not all 表示“并非全部”
see + 宾语 + V-ing 描述看到正在发生的动作

grammar.pattern: feel / look / taste + 形容词
grammar.meaning: 感官系动词后用形容词描述状态
grammar.anchor: Apples taste good to these giraffes.
grammar.example: The giraffes look healthy. The apples taste good.
grammar.tip: 系动词后一般不用副词；表示味道好应说 taste good。

grammar.pattern: Not all + 复数名词/代词 + ...
grammar.anchor: Not all of them are pink.
grammar.example: Not all animals sleep at night.
grammar.tip: not all 是部分否定，不等于 none。

grammar.pattern: see + 宾语 + V-ing
grammar.meaning: 看到某人/某物正在做某事
grammar.anchor: I saw Momo keeping his head under water.
grammar.example: We saw the elephants walking slowly.
grammar.tip: 强调正在发生的动作时用 V-ing。

pitfalls.why: taste 作系动词表示“尝起来”时，后接形容词。
要表达“并非所有”时用 not all 更清楚。
教材采用 be different from 的固定搭配。

unit-5.summary: 学习看病、身体不适和健康建议的表达，能够询问建议并给出清晰的健康提醒。
focus: should / need to / can 给建议
Don't forget to + 动词原形
less 与 fewer 的区别

grammar.pattern: What should I do? / You should ...
grammar.anchor: What should I do then?
grammar.example: You should rest and drink more water.
grammar.tip: should 后接动词原形。

grammar.pattern: Don't forget to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: Don't forget to do eye exercises twice a day.
grammar.example: Don't forget to take your medicine.
grammar.tip: forget to do 表示“忘记要做”；与 forget doing 含义不同。

grammar.pattern: less + 不可数名词 / fewer + 可数名词复数
grammar.anchor: watch less TV and play fewer computer games
grammar.example: Drink less cola and eat fewer sweets.
grammar.tip: games 是可数复数，用 fewer。

pitfalls.why: 情态动词 should 后直接接动词原形。

pitfalls.wrong: Don't forget doing your eye exercises.
pitfalls.right: Don't forget to do your eye exercises.
pitfalls.why: 提醒将要做的事情用 forget to do。
water 是不可数名词。

unit-6.summary: 围绕面对挑战、成长和坚持展开，重点复习 be 动词的一般过去时，并学习 used to 等表达过去状态的结构。
focus: was / were 描述过去状态
used to + 动词原形表示过去常常/曾经
be unable to + 动词原形

grammar.pattern: 主语 + was / were + ...
grammar.meaning: 描述过去的状态或特征
grammar.anchor: You were shy and quiet.
grammar.example: I was nervous at first. They were confident later.
grammar.tip: I/he/she/it 用 was；you/we/they 用 were。

grammar.pattern: used to + 动词原形
grammar.meaning: 过去常常/曾经……（现在可能不同）
grammar.anchor: I used to be very nervous.
grammar.example: He used to be afraid of speaking in public.
grammar.tip: used to 后接动词原形；不要写 used to was。

grammar.pattern: be unable to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: I was still unable to speak.
grammar.example: She was unable to walk at that time.
grammar.tip: unable 后常接 to do。

pitfalls.why: I 的一般过去时 be 动词用 was。
used to 后接动词原形。
didn't 后接动词原形。

unit-7.summary: 学习介绍科学家、发现和发明，能够用同位语简洁说明人物身份，并用过去时描述人物经历。
focus: 名词同位语介绍人物身份
一般过去时描述生平
discover 与 invent、be known as 等高频表达

grammar.pattern: 人名, + 身份名词短语
grammar.meaning: 同位语，用来补充说明人物身份
grammar.anchor: This is Tu Youyou, a Nobel Prize winner.
grammar.example: This is Qian Xuesen, a rocket scientist.
grammar.tip: 同位语与前面的名词指同一个人，中间常用逗号隔开。

grammar.pattern: was/were born + 地点/时间
grammar.anchor: Yuan Longping was born in Beijing in 1930.
grammar.example: The scientist was born in Shanghai.
grammar.tip: 表示出生固定用 be born。

grammar.pattern: be known as + 身份/称号
grammar.anchor: Mr Yuan is known as the 'Father of Hybrid Rice'.
grammar.example: She is known as a great scientist.
grammar.tip: be known as 强调身份/称号；be known for 强调因某事而出名。

pitfalls.wrong: Scientists invent facts that already exist.
pitfalls.right: Scientists discover facts; people invent new things.
pitfalls.why: discover 强调发现原本存在的事物；invent 强调创造新事物。

pitfalls.wrong: He is known for the 'Father of Hybrid Rice'.
pitfalls.right: He is known as the 'Father of Hybrid Rice'.
pitfalls.why: 称号用 be known as。
年份前使用 in。

unit-8.summary: 围绕发明及其用途展开，学习说明“做某事很重要”，并掌握发明类说明文中的常见结构。
focus: It is + adj. + to do
make + 宾语 + 形容词
help + 宾语 + 动词原形

grammar.pattern: It is + 形容词 + to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: It's important to find out more.
grammar.example: It is useful to learn how inventions work.
grammar.tip: 真正的动作放在 to do 后面，it 是形式主语。

grammar.pattern: make + 宾语 + 形容词
grammar.anchor: Wheels make housework much easier.
grammar.example: This tool makes our work easier.
grammar.tip: make 后先接宾语，再接形容词描述结果。

grammar.pattern: help + 宾语 + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: Wheels help people travel around easily.
grammar.example: Robots help people do difficult jobs.
grammar.tip: 本单元常用 help sb do sth。

pitfalls.wrong: It is important find out more.
pitfalls.right: It is important to find out more.
pitfalls.why: It is + adj. 后接 to do。

pitfalls.wrong: one of the most important invention
pitfalls.right: one of the most important inventions
pitfalls.why: one of 后接可数名词复数。
表示“多亏/由于”用 thanks to；thanks for 表示“感谢……”。

unit-9.summary: 学习电脑常识、操作和问题解决，重点掌握 as ... as 同级比较，并能用清晰步骤给出电脑使用建议。
focus: as + 形容词 + as 同级比较
use ... to do 表示用途
by + V-ing 表示方式

grammar.pattern: as + 形容词原级 + as
grammar.anchor: It was as big as a room.
grammar.example: The chip is as small as a grain of salt.
grammar.tip: as ... as 中不能用 bigger/smaller 等比较级。

grammar.pattern: use + 物 + to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: Students use computers to study.
grammar.example: We use a password to protect our files.
grammar.tip: to 后接动词原形。

grammar.pattern: by + V-ing
grammar.anchor: set a password by using eight different letters, numbers and symbols
grammar.example: You can learn more by searching for information.
grammar.tip: 介词 by 后接动名词。

pitfalls.why: as ... as 使用形容词原级。

pitfalls.right: much information / a lot of information
pitfalls.why: information 是不可数名词。
介词 by 后接 V-ing。

unit-10.summary: 学习绿色生活中的减量、再利用和回收，能够说明环保习惯及其作用。
focus: It is a good way to + 动词原形
remind sb to do
make ... into ... 与 be made from

grammar.pattern: It is a good way to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: It is a good way to save energy.
grammar.example: Walking is a good way to reduce air pollution.
grammar.tip: way 后常接 to do 表示“做……的方法”。

grammar.pattern: remind + 人 + to + 动词原形
grammar.anchor: I remind my mum to unplug the TV.
grammar.example: Please remind me to turn off the tap.
grammar.tip: 不要漏掉 to。

grammar.pattern: make A into B / be made from
grammar.meaning: 把 A 做成 B / 由原材料制成
grammar.anchor: Paper is made from wood.
grammar.example: We can make old boxes into a toy.
grammar.tip: 原材料发生明显变化时常用 be made from。

phrases.cn: 由……制成（原材料发生变化）

pitfalls.wrong: It is a good way for save energy.
pitfalls.right: It is a good way to save energy.
pitfalls.why: way 表示“做某事的方法”时常接 to do。

pitfalls.wrong: remind me turn off the light
pitfalls.right: remind me to turn off the light
pitfalls.why: remind sb to do sth 是固定结构。
教材强调原材料发生变化后的成品关系，使用 be made from。
